ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 80-85% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobe areas versus 15-20% low-intensity black pixels along the margins and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark peripheral band along the leading and trailing edges; a distinct vertical dark streak extending from the peduncle insertion; scattered low-intensity pixel clusters (speckling) across both lobes; high-contrast dark clusters localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 45 degrees; depth is significant, roughly 1/6th of the vertical fluke height from the baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks/valleys increases significantly at the lateral tips due to organic encrustation; central portions show micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the primary lobe surface, tapering into narrow, slightly upward-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of dark, circular relief-heavy pixels on the outer lateral tips (barnacle colonies); several faint, low-contrast circular 'ghost' rings visible on the interior white surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear streaks; two prominent diagonal marks on the lower left lobe; three distinct parallel vertical-oblique lines on the lower right lobe near the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation on the fluke tips creating jagged, non-geometric edge distortions; visible dark rake marks/scratches on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, high-contrast vertical pigmentation line originating from the base and terminating before the notch.
